items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMzAyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--428789535e7c3039c185f53aeb1dafff592214a3/BCC%202026%20for%20Canva.ai%20(1800%20x%201800%20px)%20(1).png) ##CubingBC and Speedcubing Canada welcome you to BC Championship 2026! **Everybody is welcome to compete at the second-ever BC Championship!** Competitors from any country or region are invited to register, whether you’re a seasoned competitor or this is your very first competition. The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#66713-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information. For information regarding FMC, 4BLD, 5BLD, and MBLD, please refer to the [FMC/BLIND](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#67514-fmc-blind) tab. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition. All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations prior to competing. If this is your first competition, please refer to the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#62666-faq-resources) tab for helpful tips. --- To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) and follow CubingBC on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/p/Cubingbc-61569731858139/) or [Instagram.](https://www.instagram.com/cubingbc/) Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3ac052458bf99a2d6ce589b161550c7321f8e669/CubingBC%20and%20SpeedcubingCanadaLogo.png) **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety:** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

items.name: Couffoul'Events 2026
items.information: L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€. Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#75708-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). ---- Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#75708-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.name: Eagle of the East Baku 2026
items.information: Cənubi Qafqazın ən böyük şəhəri olan, Azərbaycanın şərqində qartal kimi ucalan və Xəzərin sahilində yerləşən gözəl Bakımıza xoş gəlmisiniz! **Şərq Qartalı Bakı 2026 (Eagle of the East Baku 2026)** bütün kubsevərlər üçün açıq olan, dostluq və rəqabət ruhunu bir araya gətirən möhtəşəm bir Rubik kubu yarışıdır. Ənənəyə çevrilmiş bu yarışda 2026-cı ildə də həm yeni iştirakçıları, həm də təcrübəli speedcuber-ləri bir arada görməkdən böyük məmnunluq duyacağıq. Sürət, həyəcan və unudulmaz anlarla dolu bu yarışda sizi də aramızda görməyə şad olarıq! **Eagle of the East Baku 2026** yarışı [Azərbaycan Kub Assosiasiyası](https://aka.az/) tərəfindən təşkil olunur. Welcome once again to Baku - the largest city in the South Caucasus, proudly rising in the eagle-shaped eastern part of Azerbaijan and beautifully located on the shores of the Caspian Sea! **Eagle of the East Baku 2026** is a friendly and exciting Rubik’s Cube competition open to everyone who wants to participate. Continuing the tradition with renewed energy, we are thrilled to bring cubers together once again in 2026 and hope to welcome many new and returning participants from near and far. Join us for a competition full of speed, fun, community spirit, and unforgettable moments! **Eagle of the East Baku 2026** competition is organized by [Azerbaijan Cube Association](https://aka.az/).

items.name: Missouri Championship 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAwMzUyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--939fc012670dcd192564b199dee957c4d8084872/image.png) **This is a multi-site competition in Raymore, Missouri.** PBQ events (3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD, and FMC) will be held on August 7th at Centerview in Harrelson Hall B **(Address: 227 Municipal Cir, Raymore, MO)**. If you are not participating in these events, you are not required or obligated to attend this day, but you are welcome if you wish. All other events will be held on Saturday August 8th and Sunday August 9th at the Raymore Activity Center. The venues are both located in Raymore, about 2 miles apart. We have a local facebook group where we will be posting upcoming events as they are announced as well as supporting local cubing conversations for Missouri. Jump over and join the [Missouri Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1548283828980986) facebook group.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2026
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2026#76045-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2026#76045-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
